meaning: Chen Yu is a doctor. He works at a hospital and is tired every day.

text: 我的手机号是一三九，零零一七。
pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī hào shì yāo sān jiǔ, líng líng yāo qī.
Wéi, nǐ hǎo! Wǒ shì Lín Ān.

text: 我没有你的手机号。你给我打电话吧！
pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu nǐ de shǒujī hào. Nǐ gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà ba!
meaning: I don't have your number. Give me a call!

text: 这件衣服很好看，可是太贵了。老板，便宜一点儿吧！
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu hěn hǎokàn, kěshì tài guì le. Lǎobǎn, piányi yìdiǎnr ba!
meaning: This top looks great, but it's too expensive. Could you go a bit cheaper?

pinyin: Cóng zhèr dào dìtiězhàn yuǎn ma?
meaning: Is the metro far from here?

text: 我明天坐飞机回家。从这儿到机场很远，打车要一个小时。
pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān zuò fēijī huí jiā. Cóng zhèr dào jīchǎng hěn yuǎn, dǎchē yào yí ge xiǎoshí.
meaning: I fly home tomorrow. The airport is far from here; a taxi takes an hour.
Your room is on the right.

pinyin: Qǐng zuò, hē diǎnr chá ba.

text: 欢迎！请进！别客气，这是你的家。
pinyin: Huānyíng! Qǐng jìn! Bié kèqi, zhè shì nǐ de jiā.
meaning: Welcome! Come in! Make yourself at home.

pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng qù yīyuàn kànbìng.
meaning: I don't want to go to the doctor.
The doctor says to rest a lot.

pinyin: Wǒ bìng le, bù néng qù shàngkè.
meaning: I'm ill; I can't come to class.

text: 安娜感冒了，头很疼。医生说她要多休息。
pinyin: Ānnà gǎnmào le, tóu hěn téng. Yīshēng shuō tā yào duō xiūxi.
meaning: Anna has a cold and a bad headache. The doctor says she needs lots of rest.

pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān kàn le liǎng ge diànyǐng.

text: 昨天我和朋友去爬山了。山很高，我们都很累。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ hé péngyou qù pá shān le. Shān hěn gāo, wǒmen dōu hěn lèi.
meaning: Yesterday I went hiking with friends. The mountain was high; we were all tired.

pinyin: Wǒ bú huì chàng Zhōngwén gē.

text: 星期六我们去唱歌。安娜唱了一首中文歌，非常好听！
pinyin: Xīngqīliù wǒmen qù chànggē. Ānnà chàng le yì shǒu Zhōngwén gē, fēicháng hǎotīng!
meaning: On Saturday we went to karaoke. Anna sang a Chinese song; it was lovely!

pinyin: Wǒ kàn dào dì sān jí le.

text: 我每天晚上看中国电视剧。他们说话很快，可是有中文字幕，我能看懂。
pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān wǎnshang kàn Zhōngguó diànshìjù. Tāmen shuōhuà hěn kuài, kěshì yǒu Zhōngwén zìmù, wǒ néng kàndǒng.
meaning: I watch a Chinese drama every evening. They talk fast, but there are Chinese subtitles, so I can follow it.
